CmdIdent.description: An identifier: non-empty, one line, NFC, without leading or trailing white space (doc 05 §3.2).

CmdUuid.description: A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Dec3.description: A canonical decimal string: at most three fraction digits, no trailing fraction zeros, no leading zeros, no plus sign, no "-0", no exponent, no white space, no unit (doc 05 §3.2). The pattern bounds the integer part to 16 digits; the exact i64 range of the thousandths (about 9.2 x 10^15) is checked by the reader.

Ident.description: An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

PartRef.description: A part on a device (doc 03 §7): the embedded copy and an optional part variant (FR-PRT-003).

copy.description: The copy ID of the embedded part, `v5(NS_LIBCOPY, library ‖ item)`.

variant.description: A variant key of the part.

PartUse.description: A part use on a device (ADR-0006): the part and its quantity in the part's order unit.

qty.description: The quantity in the part's order unit (pieces, metres, sets).

Slot.description: A structure slot: a structure node ID or "none"; absent means inherit (doc 05 §3.2).

description:
`valve.add` (`AddValve`, doc 11 §4.3 `valve.add{module, position?, part}`): adds a valve child to a
module (sub-base) of a valve terminal.

Creates `Device {tag: {letter, counter: position, scheme: child}, parent: module, position, structure,
parts: [part]}` (doc 11 §3.2: the child rule prints `{parent}-{letter}{position}`; normaliser N-FL-2
keeps the counter equal to the position) and, with `fndef`, its main function `{def: fndef, role: main,
kind: normal}`. The position is the requested one, else the lowest free position of the module (1, 2,
…). The module, the part copy and the FnDef copy must exist. Rejected: position 0 (at `/position`); a
requested position another child of the module holds (no push insert in v0). Not in v0: the coil
functions from the part's `solenoids` (N-FL-1; give `fndef`), the slot-count bound of the module's part
(EW-FL-003 is a check) and the coil-to-channel binding by the part's position map (N2: bind with
`plc.bind_channel`). The state (spare valves) and the function text are set with `fields.set`.
Outcome: the valve.

fndef.description: The FnDef copy of the valve's main function.

letter.description: The letter code; default `Q` (directional valves in the shipped EN 81346-2:2009 set).

module.description: The module (sub-base) the valve sits on.

position.description: The requested position (1-based); default the lowest free one.

structure.description: Own structure assignment; default none (inherited from the parent).

title: valve.add
